items.summary: Financial recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and authorize no spend, billing changes, money movement, monetization expansion, or new queue admission. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; $4.92 is not site-attributable. AI usage is $945.247286 from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-29, so it cannot be compared to one revenue day. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, budget exposure, infrastructure spend, cost-to-learn, forecasts, and causal lift are unknown. Reject the candidate control-plane and content proposals for implementation this cycle; continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation and measurement work.
